mentions.name: modmask
mentions.description: A minimal X11 application that prints the keyboard state and keycode on every key press, built to look up the state of special function keys like Alt-GR without searching the web. It began as the st terminal with unused functionality stripped out, and was ultimately rebuilt from a minimal Rosetta Code window-creation example.
mentions.problem: Finding the keyboard state of special function keys like Alt-GR previously required searching the web.
mentions.source_excerpt: A minimal X11 application that prints state and keycode on key press. I needed the state for special function keys like Alt-GR, but I didn't want to search the web for it.
